exposure: Intravenous dexmedetomidine 1mcg/kg 10 minutes before induction of general anesthesia
cohort: 90 full-term parturients aged 20-33 years scheduled for elective caesarean delivery under general anesthesia.
finding: A loading dose of 1mcg/kg intravenous dexmedetomidine effectively prevented consciousness during general anesthesia for cesarean delivery without affecting the Apgar score.
